title: An Unhelpful Aid
summary: An experienced diver is found drowned in shallow water. DI Poole and Camille are away so Fidel and Dwayne work on the investigation along with DS Angela Young
method: The victim was drowned in a fish tank the night before and then thrown into the ocean the next day in scuba gear. Dwayne was called to the scene for a shed break-in to establish an alibi for the suspect.
motive: The victim uncovered the killer's smuggling operation and stole some diamonds.
notes: Camille was absent for most of the episode and only shows up at the very end. DS Angela Young is portrayed as very demeaning and belittling to the staff, as she calls Fidel by the wrong name and comments on why they are officers and she is a sergeant. Subplot about DI Poole being sick and Catherine making him chicken soup.
